context-title.purpose: Current deck, player, or media title.

motion.name: navigation-state
motion.purpose: Selected navigation feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .pp-primary { font:600 14px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 12px; background:var(--primary,#72d8e6); color:var(--primary-contrast,#06131a); cursor:pointer; } .pp-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary,#72d8e6); outline-offset:3px; } .pp-primary:disabled { opacity:.46; cursor:default; }

components.name: Native held key
components.description: Accent state for a pressed or latched physical key.
components.css: .pp-key { font:14px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; height:44px; min-width:44px; border:1px solid var(--primary,#72d8e6); border-radius:7px; padding:4px 8px; color:var(--primary-contrast,#06131a); background:var(--primary,#72d8e6); touch-action:none; } .pp-key:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary,#72d8e6); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Labelled field
components.css: .pp-label { display:grid; gap:6px; font:13px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; color:var(--text-main,#eef7fa); } .pp-field { box-sizing:border-box; min-height:44px; width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border-color,#344957); border-radius:8px; font:16px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; color:var(--text-main,#eef7fa); background:var(--bg-surface,#1a2a37); } .pp-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary,#72d8e6); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: Timer, keyboard groups, and shortcuts show a trailing chevron that reverses on expansion.
components.css: .pp-disclosure { font:14px "Segoe UI",sans-serif; color:var(--text-main,#eef7fa); border-top:1px solid var(--border-color,#344957); } .pp-disclosure summary { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; gap:12px; } .pp-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .pp-disclosure summary::after { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; flex-shrink:0; border:solid var(--text-muted,#b4c8d2); border-width:0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform:rotate(45deg); margin-right:4px; } .pp-disclosure[open] summary::after { transform:rotate(225deg); } .pp-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary,#72d8e6); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Touch marker
components.description: Hidden at rest, visible only during active touch.
components.css: .pp-touch { position:relative; height:90px; background:var(--bg-surface,#1a2a37); border:1px solid var(--border-color,#344957); border-radius:16px; } .pp-marker { position:absolute; top:27px; left:calc(50% - 18px); width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--primary,#72d8e6); opacity:0; pointer-events:none; } .pp-marker.active { opacity:.18; }

narrative.overview: Slate surfaces, readable desktop context, and precise accent states. Large usable movement space and clear task feedback lead; system typography, five themes, and the mouse mark preserve TouchHelm identity.

rules.name: Real context
rules.body: Unknown provider values remain unknown; capability messages describe available actions.

dos: Preserve 44px command targets, focus, safe areas and reduced motion.
Use context before actions and retain offline drafts.
donts: Do not fabricate slide counts, playlists or ready states.
Do not duplicate Windows Start or move typing out of Trackpad.
